about_the_game:
This is the original soundtrack for "Girl Like A Dreaming Two in a Restless Night", capturing the world of the game through its music.
It features the background tracks used in the game, allowing listeners to relive the journey and battles of its characters through sound.

Featuring 15 tracks built around memorable melodies and expressive piano arrangements.
Enjoy the wide range of emotions—from the lingering warmth of the story to the intensity of battle.
